extracted.intended_audience: prospective and current students of improv and sketch comedy (beginners through seasoned performers); also organizations seeking corporate training
extracted.subtask_description: Information and program-level guidance for enrolling in and participating in The Second City Training Center's improv and sketch comedy classes in Chicago, including course offerings, performances, and student support. Targets people at any experience level as well as organizations seeking corporate programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Classes for all levels of experience
rubrics_metrics.description: We offer a variety of classes in the performance arts for students at any level of experience. Whether a seasoned performer or someone who's never been onstage, you are encouraged to take classes with us.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended to be inclusive of complete beginners through experienced performers; course placement and offerings should accommodate differing starting points and goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow Second City traditions while encouraging continued growth
rubrics_metrics.description: The Training Center follows the traditions developed by these groundbreaking and innovative men and women while encouraging the continued growth and development of the art forms of comedy and improvisation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Curriculum balances preservation of established Second City methods/approaches with encouragement of innovation and artistic development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support diverse student backgrounds and individual goals
rubrics_metrics.description: Our students come from a diverse array of backgrounds, each with a unique accomplishment they wish to achieve with our courses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs should recognize and accommodate varied motivations and outcomes (e.g., professional development, hobbyist learning, specific performance goals).

rubrics_metrics.name: Student support and open communication
rubrics_metrics.description: Whatever your reasons for taking classes with us, we are here to support you and help you grow your skills. Please do not hesitate to contact our offices with any questions or concerns you might have.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accessible administrative and instructional support is a component of the program; students should be encouraged to ask questions and raise concerns.

rubrics_metrics.name: End-of-term class performances
rubrics_metrics.description: See our schedule of end-of-term class performances by our students.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Courses include performance opportunities at the end of term; students should expect and prepare for an in-class or public showcase as a learning milestone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provision of course catalog and registration procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Download a printable version of the Training Center Course Catalog (PDF). The next term is just around the corner! We have classes for all ages and levels of experience. Browse our course catalog, or register now!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Students are expected to consult the catalog for offerings and follow published registration steps and deadlines (see academic calendar).

rubrics_metrics.name: Academic calendar and important dates
rubrics_metrics.description: Don’t Miss a Class! See all the important dates for the entire calendar year. see academic calendar
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scheduling, term start/end dates, and special events are governed by the academic calendar; attendance and planning should follow those dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promotional and community engagement via TC Spotlights
rubrics_metrics.description: The Second City Training Center shines the Spotlight on students, student-performers, teachers, and training center faculty in The Second City Spotlight! Join us for interesting interviews, podcasts, blogs and more all about the TC experience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Students and faculty may be featured in interviews/podcasts/blogs as part of community engagement and publicity; participation may be encouraged to showcase work and learning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Corporate training offering (Second City Communications)
rubrics_metrics.description: If you're looking for corporate training, visit our business services division, Second City Communications
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organizations seeking customized corporate programs should use the separate business services division rather than the standard class catalog.
